evidence_quotes.section1_missing_quid_pro_quo: Calvin jumps directly into 'is it a reversal of the last move' with no time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote.
evidence_quotes.section1_discovery: Moving day (Sunday the 27th or Friday/Saturday split), current location (Madi Street unit 419), destination (fourth floor with elevator) — missing explicit destination address and approximate home size.
evidence_quotes.section2_their_agenda_missing: Never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — the customer volunteers concerns (landlord issues, short notice, packing help needed, parking/loading dock logistics) but Calvin never explicitly asks for their agenda.
evidence_quotes.section3_packing_offered: Calvin: 'Were you needing any help packing boxes this time or?' and later discusses packing timeline and rates.
evidence_quotes.section3_box_count_missing: No box count or overflow check offered — only a generic '3.5 to 5.5 hours for each portion' for a two-bedroom.
evidence_quotes.section4_estimate_anchor: Calvin provides hourly rate ($210 for three-man crew), estimated total around $2,527 for packing and moving combined, but does not anchor with a typical range for a home this size — the estimate is personalized to the customer's situation but lacks the typical-range framing.
evidence_quotes.section4_pricing_framing: Calvin mentions 15-minute increments ('we bill in the fifteen minute increments') but does not disclose trip fee, overnight fee, or packing materials upfront as required — materials ($217) emerge in the breakdown. No '2.5-hour minimum' or 'not a guess' commitment framing.
evidence_quotes.section4_feels_fair_silence: After quoting $2,527, Calvin never asks 'Does that feel fair?' — the customer says 'that would work' unprompted, but no explicit check or silence held.
evidence_quotes.section5_closes_the_loop: No recap or 'Does that put those to rest?' asked.
evidence_quotes.section6_final_concerns: No genuine 'What's still concerning you?' asked — the call ends with customer saying they need to call the building about loading dock logistics and will call back.
evidence_quotes.section7_explicit_ask: No direct 'Would you like our help with your move?' — instead, Calvin offers to book tentatively: 'I can schedule... there's no deposit. There's no rescheduling fee, there's no cancellation fee.' The customer agrees passively but is never directly asked to commit.
evidence_quotes.section7_rate_lock: Calvin: 'there's no deposit. There's no rescheduling fee, there's no cancellation fee. So there's not gonna be any monetary penalty' — rate lock implicitly framed as part of no-penalty booking.
evidence_quotes.section7_booking: Partial — moving dates offered (Friday/Saturday or Sunday options), arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM Sunday), crew size (three guys), current address (Madi Street 419) and destination floor (fourth with elevator) mentioned, but no final address confirmation or confirmation call from customer — call ends with customer saying they will call back after checking with building.

top_strength: Calvin expertly navigated a complex, multi-option logistics puzzle (Friday packing + Saturday move vs. Sunday all-in-one vs. Friday packing + Saturday afternoon move) and offered creative scheduling flexibility to match the customer's constraints.
coaching_note: Before diving into logistics, ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' (Section 2) — this customer had real concerns (landlord stress, tight timeline, parking complexity) that deserved two layers of follow-up and a reflection, not just reactive accommodation; also ask 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing (Section 4) and never skip the Two Promises (Section 5) and final concerns check (Section 6) even on continuity customers.
booking_note: Calvin explicitly booked Friday and Saturday: 'I can book the Friday, Saturday there's no deposit. There's no rescheduling fee, there's no cancellation fee... we have the trucks kind of held' and Reuben confirmed 'That would be terrific. Yeah, thank you so much.'
